title: End card
summary: The last 6 s of any piece: the wordmark arrives, one plain line, the action typed in, a hold.

params.name: line
params.description: what the brand is; empty reads IDENTITY.md

params.name: background
params.description: a background id from the registry; empty uses the brand's first

usage:
npx paper-motion add end-card --name my-piece
# edit CONFIG in pieces/my-piece/scene.html, then:
npx paper-motion render pieces/my-piece/scene.html --motion-blur 5
notes: Wired to the brand folder: needs brand/tokens.json (a palette and a font pair work: pamo add sage-night instrument) and, for the background, a shader-set entry (pamo add mesh-sage).
Structure and timing only; the look always comes from the brand.
Uses these moves from the engine: word-rise, blur-in, type-on.
